CANCELLED BY OPERATOR SCOPE CORRECTION (2026-08-18) -- PREPARED FOR SHIP-OWNED ABANDONMENT. Stage has NOT claimed this shipment (P-010 role boundary: Stage may not claim, abandon, or ship). Status remains `queued`. Operator ruled `.backlogit` remains a supported workspace root, `.backlog` is default for NEW workspaces only, and existing workspaces need no migration; the self-migration premise is withdrawn. All 10 member items (129-F, 129.001-T..129.009-T) are now `rejected`. Decision artifact: docs/decisions/2026-08-18-backlogit-legacy-root-support-operator-scope-correction.md (see section 5).

TOOL LIMITATION (explicit): backlogit exposes NO `shipment abandon` command and NO abandon MCP operation -- `backlogit shipment --help` offers only add|claim|create|get|list|return-blocked|ship. The ONLY supported route to `abandoned` is the generic `backlogit move`. TRANSITION CONSTRAINT: per .backlogit/hooks.yaml lifecycle.transitions, queued->[active,blocked] and active->[done,blocked,review,shipped,abandoned]. There is NO direct queued->abandoned transition, so the shipment MUST be claimed first; the claim is a mechanical prerequisite of cancellation, NOT an intent to execute the shipment contents.

EXACT SHIP SEQUENCE: (0) PREREQUISITE -- 140-S must be shipped first; 138-S carries an explicit blocks edge on it (deps now: 139-S shipped, 140-S queued). Do not force past it. (1) `backlogit shipment claim 138-S`  [queued->active]. (2) `backlogit move 138-S --status abandoned`  [active->abandoned]. (3) `backlogit shipment get 138-S` to verify status: abandoned.

SHIP MUST NOT: create a branch for 138-S, execute any of 129.001-T..129.009-T, rename/create/delete any storage root, open a PR for the migration, or run `backlogit shipment ship 138-S`.

SAFEST TRACEABLE ALTERNATIVE if step 2 is refused (e.g. gate broker rejects a generic move on a shipment artifact): do NOT force it and do NOT hand-edit the shipment markdown. Leave 138-S `active`, record the refusal verbatim, and escalate to the operator. An `active` shipment carrying a recorded cancellation decision is recoverable; a hand-mutated record or a `blocked` shipment status is a DEAD END -- `blocked` is not a defined ShipmentStatus constant and can never legally transition out (docs/compound/2026-05-07-backlogit-shipment-status-constraints.md, correction of 2026-08-04).
